name: OnlyFlix Local
description: OnlyFlix Local local-first build: CDNM, VidAPI, NontonGo and VidFast resolve on the Nuvio device first, with cloud fallback only when the local upstream path fails.

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · CDNM
scrapers.description: Fully local-first CDNM: device-local TMDB→IMDb lookup, PlayerJS decoding and IP-bound HLS generation; Vercel only falls back for IMDb mapping if local lookup fails.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidAPI
scrapers.description: Local-first VidAPI/VAPlayer API on the device; cloud resolver only if both local referer paths fail.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · NontonGo
scrapers.description: Local-first NontonGo multisourcesoap parsing plus device-side HEAD filtering of dead Soap2 nodes; cloud resolver only if local discovery yields no live candidates.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidFast
scrapers.description: Local-first VidFast native token + enc/dec protocol on the device; cloud resolver only if all VidFast domains fail.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local
